title: The first moving images filmed in Madagascar
description: Filmada's earlier chronology identifies images filmed by Louis Tinayre in 1900 as the first moving images made in Madagascar. By 1910, colonial and ethnographic films were recording ceremonies, work and everyday life, including films associated with Alfred Machin. These records need stronger archival citations and should be read in the context of the colonial gaze that produced them.

sources.note: Recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; archival verification remains necessary.
